classification: pre-browser harness audit setup failure; no Chromium was launched
reason: auditReleaseArtifact rejected Pages builder generated game/index.html redirect wrapper as outside the release manifest. The actual Pages output intentionally contains this wrapper; revised harness checks exact manifest path equality with only that known wrapper excluded, then runs reference isolation over the manifest files and all Pages files.

classification: pre-final-viewports harness URL-source assumption failure; app/browser had no recorded errors
reason: Actual emitted iframe HTML loads src/ui/arena-shell-bootstrap.js, while src/ui/arena-shell-entry.js is a separate standalone module in the release manifest. The revised audit verifies the browser-observed bootstrap URL against the emitted release manifest, then imports the controller module URL derived from standaloneModules in that same emitted manifest.

classification: pre-Battle harness release-path assumption failure; browser and app had no recorded errors
reason: Registered visual manifest asset paths are relative to public/assets, while release-manifest paths include public/. Browser-observed arena URL correctly used /game/public/assets/moss-ember-arena-painted.webp. Revised audit now resolves each source registration to its exact emitted release-manifest path and checks the rendered URL against that path.

classification: pre-controller harness Playwright call-signature failure; app/browser had no recorded errors
reason: The installed Playwright Frame.evaluate API accepts one serialized argument; the harness supplied the controller URL and deck separately. Revised harness passes both within one object.

classification: post-controller DOM probe harness failure; app/browser had no recorded errors
reason: Production HUD sets the card identifier on each data-ui=card-slot node itself, rather than a nested child. Revised audit reads slot.dataset.cardId and retains a child fallback.

classification: post-controller hand-order harness assumption failure; app/browser had no recorded errors
reason: The game deck cycle deterministically shuffles the provided eight-card deck into a four-card hand, so the rendered hand is not necessarily DISPLAY_DECK.slice(0,4). Actual rendered hand was brassbolt, briar-band, reedsting, copperskiff. Revised audit requires Briar Band to be present in the actual hand and clicks its observed slot.
